theme: A wide-open Monday, back on Florida ground.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan — a rare clear day back in St. Pete after Croatia, and the last quiet one before the girls come over tomorrow afternoon.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets for the girls' weekend
needsAttention.detail: The Orlando weekend is Sat–Sun and park tickets for the six of you are the one open item on the board — worth locking in before pickup tomorrow, and check whether your ticket type needs park reservations.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the tightest rental in that market and sells out; the board flags a refundable hold this week, which costs nothing to place now. Overdue since Sep 14.

needsAttention.title: Reschedule the girls' passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: Now that you're back from the Croatia trip, the four passport applications need a new appointment date. On the Mike + Dan board for today.

inbox.noise: About 18 unread, all newsletters and shop promos — Faherty, Hilton, NYT Cooking, Sopo Seafood, and a couple of St. Pete and Midcoast dispatches.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Autumn squash is at its sweetest now — roasting it deepens the flavor before it goes into the pot.

acts.line: The calendar's empty end to end — the morning is entirely unclaimed.
Still nothing scheduled, a clear stretch with the Orlando weekend and Maine rental still to settle.
A last quiet night on your own before the four girls arrive tomorrow afternoon.
